title: Return crossing with Beaver
beat: All four walk from tractor bank back toward picnic basket.
camera: Same picnic-bank camera as outbound, landscape unchanged.
staging: Four animals walking toward camera; no one remains waiting far bank.
alt: Beaver follows Mama, PinPin and baby PomPom back over the repaired bridge toward the picnic basket.

prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create the later RETURN crossing for this same story, landscape1536x1024: after visiting the parked tractor, all FOUR friends walk back across the bridge toward their picnic basket. IMAGE1 is the just-established outbound bridge view and is the EXACT camera/environment/bridge/tractor/basket continuity reference. Keep the SAME low camera on the PICNIC bank looking along the wooden bridge toward the far tractor bank, same framing and perspective. Do not mirror or reverse the landscape. IMAGE2 scene15-v2 supplies exact four character identities, facial details and relative sizes ONLY, not seated poses or picnic food. IMAGE3 scene14 supplies PinPin's face/body and repaired bridge details ONLY.
TIME AND MOVEMENT CHANGE: Reverse the animals' direction compared with IMAGE1, not the camera or geography. Now exactly FOUR animals are visibly stepping TOWARD CAMERA along the bridge, leaving the tractor behind and approaching the picnic bank and wicker basket at lower-right. Their faces/chests, body axes and walking paws point predominantly toward camera/near bank. Show meaningful progress on the planks, not a static greeting/group portrait. PinPin, middle-sized child hedgehog, leads near the foreground end of bridge and glances delightedly toward the basket. Mama, largest hedgehog, follows just behind him, closely beside tiny baby PomPom so his much shorter steps are apparent. Beaver in blue work vest follows behind them on the bridge, also walking toward picnic bank; he has now JOINED the family. Ensure enough unobstructed view to count all FOUR identities: one PinPin, one Mama, one much smaller baby PomPom, one Beaver. Stagger their positions gently along the bridge for visibility, without spreading them through the rails or making bridge wider. There must be NO remaining Beaver waiting on far bank and no duplicate hedgehog.
CHARACTERS: Match warm chestnut beaver with broad whiskered muzzle, two small incisors, blue vest and flat tail; cream-faced brown-quilled PinPin, round adult Mama, tiny round baby PomPom. Actual size order Mama > PinPin > baby, with perspective consistent. Fore/hind paws anatomically coherent and grounded on deck, natural steps with lifted paws allowed; no floating figures, paws fused to rails or extra limbs. Preserve each familiar facial identity and no hedgehog clothing.
ENVIRONMENT LOCK from IMAGE1: same diagonal repaired footbridge, continuous wooden planks, exact two-rail/post arrangement, stream and rocks below, big far-bank tree, ferns and flowers, familiar basket with red-white cloth on foregroundright picnic bank. Same parked red tractor upper-left on FAR bank, nose left, empty dark tandem trailer right, yellow folded crane fixed immediately behind cab at trailer front. No machinery moving, no vehicle on bridge. The tractor bank remains behind the returning group. No picnic cloth spread or food served yet; the basket waits where they left it.
Warm coherent sunlight, textured dimensional children's-book illustration matching inputs. No arrows/text/collage, no extra animals, no new bridge, no second basket, no unrelated scenery change. Directional walking and geographic continuity take precedence over showing all faces perfectly frontally.
review: Same bridge/camera/tractor/basket geography as outbound. All four now walk TOWARD camera and picnic basket: PinPin leading near bridge exit, Mama and tiny baby behind, Beaver following on bridge. No duplicate Beaver waiting far bank. Parked tractor remains on far bank, trailer empty, crane folded behind cab. Direction reversal and four-cast count clear. Foreground PinPin appears close to Mama in image height because he is nearer; child/baby distinction retained. Faces are re-rendered rather than pixel-identical; hidden limb anatomy unverified. Unpublished proposal.
